description: A total norm below max_norm: c = 1, the gradients are multiplied by 1; max_norm 100.0, shapes [[4, 5], [7]].
notes: grad_i is the gradient of param i; total_norm is the returned total norm and clipped_i the gradient after clipping. Computed in f64 on the f32 gradients and rounded once to f32 (testing-strategy.md §3.3); PyTorch's own f32 result and training.md §3.1.4's formula in f32 meet the tolerance. NaN must be NaN exactly where expected (testing-strategy.md §3.2).
